item: P1-41 — Statutory-payable card in the TAX module (read-only surfacing of the existing saagar_tax_payable bridge feed)
summary: Surface the current month's PF / ESIC / PT / GST-estimate from the already-loaded saagar_tax_payable feed as a dedicated "Statutory Payable" panel. The feed reader (getTaxPayableFeed / __taxPayFeed) and the per-card badge (taxPayableBadge/taxPayableAmount) already exist; P1-41 adds only new render helpers plus two insertion points. Primary placement is a full panel in renderDashboard (always shown — figures or an empty-hint); secondary is a compact card in renderMonth's month header, shown ONLY on the current (as-of) month page and only when a non-empty current-month entry exists, so every other month page stays byte-identical. CRITICAL month-key distinction: this card keys the feed by the CURRENT real/as-of month (matching how the bridge writes out[ym(today())]), NOT the P-1 deposit-period shift that taxPayableAmount uses for per-line badges. No new localStorage key → NO STORAGE_RULES / APP_RE change (the Wave-11 key-registration lesson does not apply here). Purely additive, read-only, no library, offline.

functionsToTouch.name: NEW feed helpers (add near existing taxPayable* helpers)
functionsToTouch.line: ~2628 (right after taxPayableLine, inside the same W2-5(b) block so they sit with getTaxPayableFeed@2589 / taxPayableBadge@2619)
functionsToTouch.change: Add module-level helpers, all reusing the EXISTING getTaxPayableFeed() (do NOT shadow __taxPayFeed): (1) fmtINR(n)=> '₹'+Math.round(Number(n)||0).toLocaleString('en-IN'); (2) fmtYMLabel(ym) => 'Mon YYYY' from a 'YYYY-MM' string via a 3-letter month array; (3) currentPayableYM() => derive 'YYYY-MM' by mirroring the curMonth IIFE@2548: read window.__stAsOf, validate /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/, else new Date(), return getFullYear()+'-'+pad(getMonth()+1); (4) getStatutoryPayable() => const feed=getTaxPayableFeed(); const keys=Object.keys(feed).filter(k=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(k)) (EXCLUDES _note); if !keys.length return null; const cy=currentPayableYM(); const ym = feed[cy] ? cy : keys.slice().sort().pop(); const rec=feed[ym]; if(!rec||typeof rec!=='object') return null; return {ym, rec, note: feed._note, isCurrent: ym===cy}; (5) renderStatutoryPayablePanel() => dashboard full panel (never '' — figures or hint, see approach); (6) renderStatutoryPayableCard(context,month) => compact month-header card, returns '' unless month===currentMonthName && getStatutoryPayable() has a NON-EMPTY current-month entry.

newKeysOrFields.kind: none (read-only consumer of an existing shell/bridge-owned key)
newKeysOrFields.name: saagar_tax_payable
newKeysOrFields.shape: { 'YYYY-MM': {month, pf, esic, pt, gstEstimate, sources[], at}, _note } — written by integration-bridge.js buildTaxPayable()@~542, already loaded by tax.html into __taxPayFeed@2588 via getTaxPayableFeed()@2589

newKeysOrFields.storageRulesNote: NO new top-level key is introduced, so NO STORAGE_RULES (index.html~1961) and NO APP_RE (index.html~5563) edit is required for P1-41. The Wave-11 'register every new key' lesson does not apply to this item. (saagar_tax_payable is owned/registered by the bridge, not by this wave.)

approach:
ADDITIVE + READ-ONLY. tax.html already reads the feed (getTaxPayableFeed@2589, __taxPayFeed@2588) and already has per-line badges (taxPayableBadge@2619). P1-41 adds a SUMMARY surface only.

MONTH-KEY DERIVATION (the load-bearing decision): the bridge writes out[m] with m=ym(today()) (integration-bridge.js@544-556) — i.e. the feed entry is keyed by the CURRENT real month. So getStatutoryPayable() targets the current/as-of month (currentPayableYM mirrors the curMonth IIFE@2548's __stAsOf-or-today logic). If feed[currentYM] is missing (common in seeded/as-of-mismatch demos where the bridge last ran on a different real date), fall back to the NEWEST feed key (max of the /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$/ keys) and set isCurrent=false so the UI labels the actual month shown. This deliberately does NOT use taxPayableAmount()'s M→1 (prev-month) shift — that shift is correct for per-deposit-line badges (deposit for wages of month M sits on the M+1 calendar page) but WRONG for a 'what you owe this month' summary card.

DASHBOARD PANEL (renderStatutoryPayablePanel, primary, always rendered): reuse existing CSS classes cos-panel + cos-panel-title@403 + ops-list/ops-row/ops-name/ops-meta/ops-val (no new CSS required). Structure:
- Title: `Statutory Payable` (uppercase via cos-panel-title) + a right-aligned month chip fmtYMLabel(ym); when isCurrent===false add ' (latest available)'.
- Four ops-rows: EPF (rec.pf), ESIC (rec.esic), Professional Tax (rec.pt), GST (estimate) (rec.gstEstimate) — each amount via fmtINR(). Show all four even at ₹0 but dim ₹0 rows (color:var(--g600)); the sources line explains a ₹0 (e.g. 'payroll(no statutory fields — see Payroll module)').
- Total row (bold, amber #92400e to match the badge): fmtINR(pf+esic+pt+gstEstimate).
- Provenance meta: `Sources: ` + escapeHtml((rec.sources||[]).join(' · ')) (fallback '—').
- Optional 'Synced ' + formatDate((rec.at||'').slice(0,10)) if rec.at present.
- Disclaimer footer: escapeHtml(note || 'Estimate — verify with CA before filing.') in muted small text; note that PF/ESIC/PT are business-wide (across payroll), GST is an estimate, and the whole card is not firm-specific.
EMPTY/HINT branch (getStatutoryPayable()===null OR all four amounts 0): render a cos-panel with the same title and a hint body: `No statutory payable computed yet. Lock this month's Payroll and enter Expense GST, then run cross-module sync from the Home screen.` (offline, no link needed).

MONTH-HEADER CARD (renderStatutoryPayableCard, secondary): returns '' unless month===currentMonthName() (compare against the same N[getMonth()] value the curMonth IIFE uses) AND getStatutoryPayable().isCurrent is true AND total>0. When shown, a compact one-line strip echoing the badge style: `₹<total> statutory payable this month · PF ₹x · ESIC ₹y · PT ₹z · GST ₹w · estimate — verify with CA`. No hint on month pages (dashboard carries the hint) so non-current / no-data month pages stay byte-identical to today.

All amounts Math.round(Number(x)||0); all interpolated feed strings pass through escapeHtml (sources[] is bridge-authored but escape defensively).
ui: Dashboard: a full-width `cos-panel` titled "STATUTORY PAYABLE" inserted directly below the 4 KPI tiles (dash-stats) in renderDashboard@~3032, above the first dash-grid-2. Four labelled amount rows (EPF / ESIC / Professional Tax / GST estimate) + bold amber Total + grey "Sources: payroll(2026-Jul) · expense.gm_tax_feed" provenance + muted "— estimate, verify with CA before filing (business-wide, not firm-specific)". Empty state = same panel with a "run cross-module sync / lock Payroll / enter Expense GST" hint. Month calendar: a slim amber one-liner in the month header (after mhd-note@2984) shown ONLY on the current/as-of month when there is data — mirrors the existing taxPayableBadge amber (#92400e / #6b7280) so it reads as the same family. No new colours, no new CSS classes required (reuses cos-panel, ops-*, dash-stats family).
edgeCases: Feed key absent entirely (getItem null) → getTaxPayableFeed()={} → getStatutoryPayable()=null → dashboard hint, no month card, 0 errors.
Feed present but only holds _note (no YYYY-MM keys) → keys filter drops _note → null → hint.

Current/as-of month has no entry but an older month does → fall back to newest key, isCurrent=false, panel labelled with that month + '(latest available)', month-header card suppressed (only shows for a genuine current-month entry).
All of pf/esic/pt=0 with sources 'payroll(no statutory fields — see Payroll module)' and gstEstimate>0 → show ₹0 dimmed rows + GST figure + that provenance so the 0 is explained, not silent.
All four amounts 0 → treat as empty (show hint on dashboard, no month card) to avoid ₹0 noise, matching the badge philosophy.
No firm selected (getActiveFirm()===null) → panel STILL renders (feed is business-wide); must NOT be gated behind a firm.
Past as-of date (isPastAsOf) → card is read-only display anyway; no writes, so no special handling needed, but confirm currentPayableYM uses __stAsOf so a past view shows that month's figure.
_note missing on an older/partial feed → fall back to fixed 'Estimate — verify with CA before filing.' string.
Non-numeric / NaN amounts in rec → Math.round(Number(x)||0) coerces to 0.
5s TTL cache on __taxPayFeed@2591 → after a fresh Home sync the card can lag up to ~5s until re-render; acceptable, note it.
verifySteps: Harness: seed localStorage.setItem('saagar_tax_payable', JSON.stringify({'2026-07':{month:'2026-07',pf:12000,esic:3500,pt:2400,gstEstimate:48000,sources:['payroll(2026-Jul)','expense.gm_tax_feed'],at:'2026-07-13T00:00:00Z'},_note:'Best-effort... Verify with CA before filing.'})) with window.__stAsOf='2026-07-13'; open tax module → Dashboard tab shows the panel with 4 figures, Total ₹65,900, sources line, verify-with-CA note; 0 console errors.
Calendar → open July page: compact amber statutory-payable strip appears in the header; open August (or any other) page: NO strip (assert the header HTML for a non-current month equals baseline).
Remove the key (localStorage.removeItem('saagar_tax_payable')) + rerender: Dashboard shows the hint panel, month pages show no strip, 0 errors.

Zero-statutory case: seed pf/esic/pt=0, gstEstimate=48000, sources includes 'payroll(no statutory fields — see Payroll module)' → panel shows dimmed ₹0 EPF/ESIC/PT rows + GST ₹48,000 + that provenance; Total ₹48,000.
As-of mismatch: seed only '2026-05' entry with __stAsOf='2026-07-13' → panel falls back to May, shows fmtYMLabel 'May 2026' + '(latest available)', month strip suppressed on all pages.
No firm selected (clear activeFirmId): confirm the dashboard panel still renders (not hidden).
Currency: verify fmtINR renders Indian grouping (₹1,20,000 style) and matches taxPayableBadge output.
Re-run the tax harness smoke (all months + dashboard) to confirm no regression to renderMonth/renderDashboard and 0 new console errors.
risks: renderMonth's htmlParts array and renderDashboard's single `html` template literal are SHARED regions — any other Wave-12 tax item that also injects into either will textually collide; synthesis owner must merge both insertion points rather than each item editing independently.
Must reuse the existing getTaxPayableFeed()/__taxPayFeed — a new helper that re-declares __taxPayFeed or a second getItem would double the state/cache and risk drift; spec explicitly reuses them.

Using taxPayableAmount()'s P-1 month shift by mistake would show last month's figures on a 'current month' card — the spec's currentPayableYM path avoids this; reviewers should confirm the card path never calls taxPayableAmount.
Gating the dashboard panel on getActiveFirm() would wrongly hide a business-wide figure when no firm is selected (common on first open) — explicitly do not gate.
5s TTL cache means a just-synced value can lag briefly; only cosmetic.

Feed values originate from the bridge (payroll rows may lack statutory fields), so figures can be ₹0/partial — the sources[] provenance + 'verify with CA' disclaimer are load-bearing to avoid the card being read as authoritative; do not drop them.
collisionNotes: "SAME-FILE (tax.html) Wave-12 neighbours: (1) P1-34 evidence-ZIP export touches the CSV export region@~2699 + snapshotAll + ensureJSZip — a DIFFERENT region from renderDashboard/renderMonth, so low collision, but if P1-34 also adds a dashboard/toolbar button it may want space near the same dash header — coordinate button placement. (2) Any Wave-12 item that adds firm-form fields / compliance fields touches saveFirm@2034 / renderFirmList / loadState — no overlap with P1-41's render helpers. (3) P1-33 (WA tax channel) lives in the SHELL WA_CFG@4514, NOT tax.html — no tax.html collision (confirmed). HARD SHARED POINTS for the synthesis owner: renderMonth@2963 htmlParts (insertion at ~2984) and renderDashboard@3002 `html` template (insertion after dash-stats). Existing feed API (getTaxPayableFeed@2589, taxPayableBadge@2619, taxPayableAmount@2606, taxPayableField@2598, taxPayableLine@2625, MONTH_IDX_CAL@2617) is REUSED read-only — P1-41 adds sibling helpers, changes none of them, so the per-line badge behaviour is unchanged. EXC_AREA_TO_MODULE@3013 already maps Tax->tax; P1-41 adds NO bridge exception (confirmed none needed)."
openQuestions: Placement scope: confirm dashboard-panel + current-month-header-strip (recommended), or dashboard-only? The strip adds calendar-context visibility but is a second insertion point to maintain.
Zero-amount lines: show all four rows with dimmed ₹0 (recommended, so provenance explains the 0) vs hide ₹0 rows (cleaner but a GST-only month looks sparse)?

Fallback behaviour when the current month has no entry: show the newest available month labelled '(latest available)' (recommended) vs show the empty hint even though older data exists? Decide which is less misleading for the CA user.
Show rec.at 'Synced <date>' timestamp on the panel (nice provenance) or omit to keep it compact?
Label wording for GST: 'GST (estimate)' distinctly vs treating all four uniformly under the single 'verify with CA' disclaimer.

Confirm the shell-owned key 'saagar_tax_payable' is intentionally EXCLUDED from tax.html's own STORAGE_RULES leaf (it is a bridge output, not a tax-module key) — so P1-41 correctly makes no registration change; synthesis owner to confirm no other Wave-12 tax item expects to register it.
